result.topic_en: Mixed notes on prime-counting functions (Chebyshev-type functions theta and psi and the identity giving log Π(x)), Riemann's P-function with its Wronskian and the triangle conformal mapping of the quotient of solutions, a spherical-metric calculation with log tan(θ/2), and algebraic functions x = f(z), x_1 = f_1(z) with F(x, x_1) = 0.

psi function as sum of theta over prime-power roots
Sum of psi(x/n) equals log of factorial function Π(x)
Wronskian of two branches of Riemann P-function
Conformal map of sphere to plane (stereographic projection) via log tan(θ/2)
Quotient of solutions maps half-plane to triangle with angles (α-α')π, (β-β')π, (γ-γ')π
